description: Produced by the Etherbor PGFN Lihmona Navy Shipyard, the Crying Sun class Light Frigate has satisfied the sprawling Federation's need for affordable force projection across its reaching territory. Lacking any true ship to ship weapons for a vessel of its size, the Crying Sun-class instead carries a Nail-class Boarding Vessel for raids, excursions, and forward scouting. The Crying Sun-class's practicality has been the subject of regular debate since its adoption, but the vessel’s imposing form and the threat of its rapidly mobile marines have proven to be more than enough in its duties so far.
